correctness.rationale: For i<j, the event A that j descends from i has probability 1/i; conditional martingale mean E[S_j(t)|F_j]=t/j gives E[A S_j(t)]=t/(ij). The exact one-step mixed-moment recurrence \(U_{t+1}=(1+2/t)U_t+1/(ij)\), with \(U_j=j/i\), is solved by \(U_t=t^2/(ij)\), proving every zero cross covariance. Two-colour beta-binomial urn supplies one-point variance. Double-counting subtree edges gives path-length identity and harmonic exact variance; rational exhaustive tests independently verify \(n\le9\). Edge cases i=1 and i=n are included. No finite enumeration is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The surprising cancellation holds across overlapping nested subtree sizes and gives the complete n-dimensional covariance, not a marginal urn exercise. It yields exact uncertainty quantification for every weighted chronological descendant-influence score and identifies which individual early subtrees contribute to path-length variance. The nontrivial zero off-diagonal law, full covariance rank, and sharp variance localization motivate the specific fact; scalar path-length formulas alone cannot provide these contributions.
